description: Local live composer dictation with Parakeet, plus voice-note transcription.
configHelp: General can inspect and set up local live composer dictation directly with supported Transcriber plugin commands (shared with the Transcriber glance panel; no need to send the owner to glance). First run `domios plugin transcriber dictation-status` (or `domios plugin transcriber help`). The Russian-capable default is Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (`parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8`, ~487 MB download); Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (`parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8`, English, ~482 MB) is optional. Setup needs ~1.5 GB free disk space, a supported 64-bit Python 3.12 (`python.exe` on Windows x64, `python3.12` on macOS/Linux x64/arm64), network access to GitHub releases and PyPI for SHA-256-verified artifacts, and local Python subprocess execution writing only inside this plugin's instance data directory. Explain these requirements and obtain explicit owner approval before running `domios plugin transcriber dictation-install parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8 --consent`. `--consent` records owner confirmation for this command only and is not a host permission grant; Domios natively enforces `agent_commands` and `subprocess` permissions (report any host refusal verbatim rather than bypassing it or using manual pip/config workarounds). Poll `dictation-progress` for real stages/MB/failures, use `dictation-cancel` to cancel an incomplete install, `dictation-select <model-id>` to switch installed models, and `dictation-test [model-id]` to run only the bundled WAV sample. Voice-note Whisper settings (`model`, `language`, `endpoint`), inbound `integrations.voice_transcribe`, microphone/OS permissions, and composer draft remain separate and untouched.
